throughput.name: 8 JIRLs x 10000 loop iterations
throughput.asm: la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop
throughput.command: ./bench --method raw --unroll 1 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r12, 1000' --asm 'la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop'
throughput.notes: A taken indirect branch retires at one per cycle: a loop with 8 static JIRLs plus the loop branch executes 9 taken branches in 9.00 cycles (measured 9009.91 cycles per 1000 iterations, reproduced within 0.1%), so the cost per branch is 1 cycle. The same measurement with 1 and 2 static JIRLs gives 1.00 cycles each. The earlier 1.279 CPI came from subtracting a loop-only baseline that shared instructions with the JIRL body. As with direct branches, a static JIRL stream larger than the BTB is expected to degrade towards 3 cycles per branch. The numbers are normalised per JIRL, so core_cycles shows the per-JIRL cost; the raw loop measurement is 9009.91 cycles for 1000 iterations of 8 JIRLs plus the loop branch.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Taken indirect branch throughput is 1 CPI when the static JIRL stream fits the BTB, with up to about 3 CPI once it does not.
